objective: Define a fail-closed, non-production Runtime Lifecycle Smoke for the exact Qwen3.5-0.8B Q8_0 + llama.cpp b11033 local payload on DESK-W-591. The smoke validates isolated clean install, governed lifecycle-revision upgrade, rollback to the prior verified revision, usability after each activated state, and final machine cleanup. It does not claim a binary-version migration because lifecycle revisions A and B intentionally bind the same immutable payload bytes.

test_semantics.install_meaning: Materialize exact immutable payload into an isolated test-owned revision-A slot and atomically activate A through a test-owned current manifest.
test_semantics.upgrade_meaning: Materialize the same exact immutable payload into a distinct revision-B slot with a distinct signed/governed lifecycle manifest, verify B completely, then atomically switch the test-owned current manifest from A to B.
test_semantics.rollback_meaning: Atomically switch the test-owned current manifest from B back to previously verified A, verify exact A identity and usability, then perform final cleanup of the entire test-owned lifecycle root.
test_semantics.reason_same_payload_revisions: No second independently qualified Windows runtime payload exists in current M1 evidence. Using the same immutable payload with distinct lifecycle revisions tests install/activation/upgrade/rollback mechanics without fabricating a runtime-binary migration claim.

activation_protocol.update_method: SAME_DIRECTORY_TEMP_FILE / CREATE_NEW / WRITE_CANONICAL_JSON / FLUSH_FILE_BUFFERS / CLOSE / REOPEN_AND_HASH_VERIFY / ONE_NATIVE_SAME_VOLUME_RENAME_OR_REPLACE_PRIMITIVE / NEVER_DELETE_CURRENT_THEN_RENAME
activation_protocol.replacement_publish: ANY_REPLACEMENT_WITH_EXISTING_CURRENT, INCLUDING NORMAL_A_TO_B, NORMAL_B_TO_A, RECOVERY_B_TO_A, AND RECOVERY_A_TO_B: USE_SINGLE_SAME_VOLUME_NATIVE_REPLACE_PRIMITIVE; OLD_OR_NEW_COMPLETE_CURRENT MAY EXIST ACROSS CRASH, BUT PARTIAL_JSON OR DELETE_THEN_GAP IS FORBIDDEN
activation_protocol.fault_injection_requirement_before_final: STATIC_NEGATIVE_AND_FAULT_INJECTION_TESTS_MUST_PROVE EVERY NORMAL_OR_RECOVERY CURRENT PUBLICATION IS OLD_OR_NEW_COMPLETE_JSON, NEVER PARTIAL, NEVER DELETE_THEN_GAP, AND ONLY THE EXACT SUCCESS_OR FAILURE-BRANCH TRANSITION GRAPH IS ACCEPTED
activation_protocol.successful_path_expected_transition_indi: SUCCESS_PATH_ONLY / FAILURE_RECOVERY_BRANCHES_USE THE SEPARATELY BOUND RECOVERY TRANSITIONS

scenario_contract.name: Clean isolated install and activation of revision A
Governed upgrade A to lifecycle revision B
Rollback B to previously verified revision A

failure_and_cleanup.on_partial_install: BEFORE_A_ACTIVATION: DO_NOT_ACTIVATE_PARTIAL_A / REMOVE_PARTIAL_A_IF_SAFE / PRESERVE_EVIDENCE. AFTER_A_ACTIVATION_BUT_BEFORE_INSTALL_PROBE_PASS: STOP_PROFILE_SERVER, REMOVE_CURRENT_IF_AND_ONLY_IF_IT_STILL_REFERENCES_UNVERIFIED_A, PRESERVE_RUNTIME_ROOT_FOR_FORENSICS_UNLESS_SAFE_CLEANUP_IS_EXACTLY_PROVEN, PRESERVE_EVIDENCE, DO_NOT_CLAIM_INSTALL_SUCCESS.
failure_and_cleanup.on_partial_upgrade: BEFORE_B_ACTIVATION: KEEP_VERIFIED_A_ACTIVE / NEVER_POINT_CURRENT_TO_PARTIAL_B. AFTER_TRANSITION_2_ACTIVATES_B_BUT_BEFORE_UPGRADE_PROBE_PASS: STOP_PROFILE_SERVER; REVERIFY_A_EXACT; IF_VALID, PUBLISH EXACT RECOVERY_TRANSITION_3 B_TO_A WITH transition_kind=RECOVERY AND recovery_of_transition_index=2, POST_VERIFY CURRENT_AND_A, RECORD RECOVERY, THEN TERMINATE PROFILE AS FAILED WITH NO FURTHER TRANSITIONS; OTHERWISE FAIL_CLOSED WITH NO SUCCESS CLAIM. PRESERVE EVIDENCE.
failure_and_cleanup.on_rollback_failure: BEFORE_A_REACTIVATION: KEEP_VERIFIED_B_ACTIVE. AFTER_NORMAL_TRANSITION_3 ACTIVATES_A_BUT_BEFORE_ROLLBACK_PROBE_PASS: STOP_PROFILE_SERVER; REVERIFY_B_EXACT; IF_VALID, PUBLISH EXACT RECOVERY_TRANSITION_4 A_TO_B WITH transition_kind=RECOVERY AND recovery_of_transition_index=3, POST_VERIFY CURRENT_AND_B, RECORD RECOVERY, THEN TERMINATE PROFILE AS FAILED WITH NO FURTHER TRANSITIONS; OTHERWISE FAIL_CLOSED. DO_NOT_CLAIM_ROLLBACK_SUCCESS / PRESERVE EVIDENCE.
failure_and_cleanup.successful_closeout_final_machine_state: TEST_OWNED_LIFECYCLE_RUNTIME_ROOT_REMOVED / PERSISTENT_ATTEMPT_GUARD_RETAINED / EVIDENCE_OUTPUT_RETAINED / BOUND_SOURCE_PAYLOAD_SET_UNCHANGED / NO_SERVER / NO_PORT_18088_LISTENER
failure_and_cleanup.failure_closeout_rule: ON_ANY_FAILURE THE ATTEMPT_GUARD_REMAINS CONSUMED. DO NOT REQUIRE DELETION OF THE RUNTIME TEST ROOT IF THAT WOULD DESTROY FORENSIC STATE; INSTEAD REQUIRE NO_PROFILE_OWNED_SERVER_AND_NO_PORT_18088_LISTENER_AND_EXACT_EVIDENCE_OF_REMAINING_TEST_OWNED_STATE.
